description: Visual check: all 5 vehicle roles render distinct 3D shapes at spawn with correct positioning

steps.description: Bumped cash from the 50k default to 200k: at 50k, only the first of 5 vehicle purchases affords -- the rest overdraw in command mode (Finding #1) but would leave 4 buy buttons permanently disabled for a real click. This is what the scenario's own premise (render all 5 vehicle types) needs.

campaign start replaces the whole GameState (createGameForLevel) including cash, reset to the level's own startingCash -- a `new_game ... cash:N` set beforehand (tried here first) is wiped the instant this step runs, regardless of order. There is no cash override for campaign start itself.

expect.note: confirms the cash:200000 bump above is wiped by dusty_hollow's own starting cash, exactly as this step's description warns
